fields.description: Issue dated May 5, 1928, edited by Wen R. Phillips. Covers Miami’s hosting of the Shriners convention alongside a convention of federal prohibition agents, emphasizing civic hospitality, publicity, and economic impacts. Includes commentary on police and courts (including the Quigg murder trial acquittal and criticism of Miami Herald editor/judge Frank Stoneman), local political campaign announcements for judicial offices, satirical items about bootlegging and enforcement, and a letter urging traffic controls at a dangerous intersection (17th Ave. and 9th St. S.W.).
